I have a few questions How does the voting system work? How do I have more points then my 3 years at Reddit?

Voting is limited when you've got a new account. you've got to get submission and comment "points" before you can upvoat.

After you clear 20 CCP, you can upvoat 10 times in a 24 hour period. Once you clear 100 CCP you can upvoat 20 times in a 24 hour period. You'll also have some downvoat functions.

Generally speaking, the more active you are with submitting comments and new content, the more you can voat up or down. Lurking is pretty well discouraged.

I don't know how much Karma you had on Reddit, but whatever. Enjoy where you started.
